slides.headline: Kyiv hit [[again.]] Truce? Nobody agrees.
bullets: **Oct 13-14:** missiles hit Kyiv a second night: **4 killed, 25 hurt**, incl. 3 women in a nine-story block (Kyiv Independent).
**Nationwide:** at least **10 killed, 91 hurt** in a day (regional officials). Zelensky claims **39 ballistic missiles**, 120+ drones, **600,000** without power.
**Truce:** Trump says both sides agreed an energy ceasefire. Kremlin (Oct 12): talks go on; Russia wants lasting peace, not a ceasefire.
slides.sources: Sources: Kyiv Independent (Oct 14), Ukrainska Pravda (Oct 12-13). Zelensky/Ukrainian officials' figures not independently verified.

slides.headline: Today in [[4 numbers]]

stats.l: Killed across Ukraine in a day; 91 injured, per regional authorities
People without power after Russian strikes, per Zelensky
Killed in Oct 10 Riyadh airport attack, Saudi authorities say (CBS reports 13)
Ship attacks near Hormuz Oct 1-14, almost double the war's monthly average

slides.sources: Sources: Kyiv Independent, Al Jazeera, CBS News/AFP. Outlets differ on the Riyadh toll.

slides.headline: Ships sunk. [[Saudi airports under fire.]]
bullets: **Hormuz:** 4 ships hit by an "unknown projectile" Oct 13 (UKMTO). Vanguard says GFS Pride sank; IRGC claims a ship hit a mine. Neither verified.
**Saudi Arabia:** Houthis vow more strikes on airports. Coalition says it downed a missile over Medina; Houthis call that "a lie."
**Riyadh airport (Oct 10):** 12 killed per Saudi authorities; CBS says 13.
**Trump** is weighing joining Saudi strikes on the Houthis.
slides.sources: Sources: CBS News/AFP, Al Jazeera, UKMTO, Vanguard. IRGC, Houthi and coalition statements are claims.

slides.headline: Truce year two. [[Still dying.]]
bullets: **Oct 13:** Israeli air strike on a car in Gaza City's Tuffah district kills 1, wounds several, per emergency services (Al Jazeera).
**Toll:** 74,382+ killed since Oct 2023 (Wafa). Al Jazeera says 1,400+ killed since the Oct 2025 truce.
**Ramallah:** 2 journalists hurt, a child hit by live fire, NGO offices raided (Wafa, Palestinian health ministry).
**Netanyahu** says Israel will extend control across the West Bank: "There will be no Arab army west of the Jordan River."
slides.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera (Oct 14), Wafa. Israeli military statements on individual strikes not available at time of writing.

slides.headline: Army: [[no talks.]] War grinds on.
bullets: **Oct 12:** army chief al-Burhan rules out negotiations with the RSF and vows to keep fighting in Darfur, Kordofan and Blue Nile (Daily Trust).
**Near El Geneina:** the army-allied Joint Force says it retook Bir Saliba. Unverified claim, one side only.
**Note:** few fresh independently confirmed reports from the last 24h; the items above are the latest we could verify.
slides.sources: Sources: Daily Trust/AllAfrica (Oct 12). Battlefield claims come from one side and are unverified.

slides.headline: This [[week]]
bullets: **Kyiv:** whether Moscow confirms the energy truce, and the final toll from the Oct 13-14 strikes.
**Hormuz:** verification of reported sinkings; Iran-Oman talks on safe shipping routes (Iran foreign ministry).
**Saudi Arabia:** Houthi follow-through; Trump's call on joining strikes. EU-GCC summit (Oct 24) postponed.
**Gaza/West Bank:** Netanyahu's push on West Bank control; truce toll.

4 wars. 24 hours. Here's what changed. ⬇️

🇺🇦 UKRAINE (Day 1,695) — Ballistic missiles hit Kyiv a second night: 4 killed, 25 injured (Kyiv Independent). Across Ukraine at least 10 killed, 91 injured in a day. Zelensky says Russia fired 39 ballistic missiles and 120+ drones and 600,000 lost power (claims). Trump says an energy ceasefire is agreed; the Kremlin says it wants lasting peace, not a ceasefire.

🇮🇷 IRAN WAR (Day 230) — Ship attacks around Hormuz are at their highest level of the war: 23 in Oct 1-14 (AFP). Vanguard says GFS Pride sank; the IRGC claims a separate ship hit a mine. Houthis vow more strikes on Saudi airports; the Oct 10 Riyadh airport attack killed 12 per Saudi authorities (CBS says 13).

🇵🇸 GAZA / WEST BANK — Israeli strike on a car in Gaza City kills 1. Two journalists hurt in Ramallah. Netanyahu says Israel will extend control across the West Bank.

🇸🇩 SUDAN — Army chief al-Burhan (Oct 12) rules out talks with the RSF.

caption_facebook:
WORLD AT WAR: Thursday, Oct 15, 2026
4 fronts, 24 hours. Here's what changed.

🇺🇦 UKRAINE (Day 1,695)
• Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv for a second night: 4 killed and 25 injured, including 3 women killed in a nine-story residential building (Kyiv Independent).
• Nationwide, regional authorities report at least 10 killed and 91 injured in a day. Zelensky says Russia launched 39 ballistic missiles and 120+ drones at energy and critical infrastructure, leaving 600,000 without power. Ukraine's air force says it downed 4 missiles and 115 drones. These are official Ukrainian claims.
• Trump says Ukraine and Russia agreed to an energy ceasefire. On Oct 12 Kremlin spokesman Peskov said consultations continue and Russia wants lasting peace, not a ceasefire.

🇮🇷 IRAN WAR (Day 230)
• Hormuz: four ships were hit by an "unknown projectile" on Oct 13 (UKMTO). Vanguard says the container ship GFS Pride sank; the IRGC separately claims a cargo ship hit a mine. Neither is verified. 23 attacks were recorded Oct 1-14, almost double the war's monthly average (AFP).
• Houthis vow more strikes on Saudi airports and oil sites. The coalition says it intercepted a missile over Medina on Oct 15; the Houthis call that a lie. The Oct 10 Riyadh airport attack killed 12 and wounded 300+ per Saudi authorities (CBS reports 13).
• Trump said Oct 8 the US would not attack Iran before the Nov 3 midterms; he is weighing joining Saudi strikes on the Houthis.

🇵🇸 GAZA / WEST BANK
• An Israeli air strike on a car in Gaza City killed one and wounded several on Oct 13, per emergency services (Al Jazeera). Gaza death toll since Oct 2023: 74,382+ (Wafa); 1,400+ since the Oct 2025 truce (Al Jazeera).
• Two journalists were wounded and NGO offices raided in Ramallah (Wafa). Netanyahu said Israel will extend control across the West Bank.

🇸🇩 SUDAN
• Army chief al-Burhan ruled out negotiations with the RSF (Daily Trust, Oct 12). The Joint Force claims it retook Bir Saliba (unverified).

WHAT TO WATCH: Kyiv's final toll and the truce; Hormuz sinkings; Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia.

Sources: Kyiv Independent, Al Jazeera, CBS News/AFP, Daily Trust. Figures are as reported by those outlets.
